comment: Independent mon.c witness for newcham() dropping a boulder: the debug Priestess wishes a wand of polymorph, creates a hill giant beside her, and zaps it; the giant was generated carrying a boulder, becomes a horned devil that cannot throw rocks, and newcham() drops the boulder through do.c flooreffects() and mkobj.c place_object(), whose boulder arm calls vision.c block_point(). I chose seed 9910005 from a scan of 9910001-9910011, reading the giant's direction from each C screen; two of the eleven giants carried a boulder.
